- **Walmart** (fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2024): operating income of about $27,012M on revenue of about $648,125M gives a margin of about 4.17%.
- **Costco** (fiscal year ended Sep 1, 2024): operating income of about $9,285M on revenue of about $254,453M gives a margin of about 3.65%.

The difference is 4.17% − 3.65% ≈ 0.52 percentage points.
